compaction_note: Full provider prompts/responses and per-call records remain in the Actions artifacts. The committed replay source retains accepted actions, aggregate usage, and the model-maintained ledger state/trace needed for deterministic evaluator replay and mechanism analysis.
heldout_note: No held-out episodes were authored or evaluated.
purpose: Durable selected-grid replay source and matched analysis for the GPT-5.6 Sol operational-ledger reactive development experiment.

recovery_selection.discard_rule: The duplicate recovery 015/r1 is excluded by key before its JSON outcome is read; the original valid 015/r1 is retained.
recovery_selection.reason: The original run exhausted OpenAI credits after the retained 43-run prefix; all 17 excluded original keys ended in ModelCallError attributable to no remaining credits.

original.execution_head_delta: One commit ahead of benchmark_code_sha; only .github/workflows/operational-ledger-reactive-full.yml changed to add a one-shot push trigger.

recovery.execution_head_delta: Workflow-only recovery invocation: one-shot push trigger plus episodes 015-020 instead of the full development suite; treatment code remained benchmark_code_sha.

storage.format: deterministic gzip(JSONL compact replay records, mtime=0) encoded once as base64 text

source_verification.canonical_compaction: JSON compact record with sort_keys=true, separators=(',', ':'), UTF-8, newline per selected record, ordered by episode index then repeat
source_verification.provenance_line_format: source_code|episode_index|repeat|sha256(exact raw run JSON bytes)|sha256(canonical compact record line)
source_verification.note: The committed per-record provenance map is generated from the two Actions ZIPs after verifying their artifact digests. CI binds every compact replay row to the expected source code, exact raw-run JSON hash, and canonical compact-row hash; the verifier script can independently reproduce the map from the downloaded artifacts.
